neighbours.label: the last word of a fixed idiom or set phrase (come to grief, carry the day, go to pieces, en vigueur, as prescribed), as opposed to the same words outside the phrase
fire: The whole scheme came to grief within a year.
In the end the reformers carried the day.
Without his wife he simply went to pieces.
La nouvelle loi est entrée en vigueur en janvier.
Take these tablets only as directed.
After three bad years the shop went to the wall.
The committee took the matter under advisement.
His last novel fell by the wayside.
quiet: The whole family came to dinner within a year.
In the end the reformers carried a banner.
Without his wife he simply went to work.
La nouvelle loi est dans le journal en janvier.
Take these tablets to your mother.
After three bad years the shop went to a cousin.
The committee took the matter to the board.
His last novel fell off the shelf.

short: completing a fixed idiom or set phrase
notes: 'entrés dans la loi' scored 0.31 in a probe, so French has a higher floor. Card flags this pole as broad (1.0%).
